shown.message:
The equal-N scaling rows now cover ten data sets and are synced to paper-repo `dev` (dd27c9c). The data sets are Arena (all-turn and single-turn), three LLM judges, MT-Bench (human and GPT-4) and three NBA seasons (1990, 2005, 2015).

- **Scaling:** for the data sets with a fitted slope, k\*/N falls as N grows. The log-log slope is about −0.33 to −0.51, so k\* grows roughly as N^0.5–0.7 in every design, and F/z stays near 1.
- **Missing slopes:** MT-Bench GPT-4 and NBA 1990 and 2015 have no fitted slope. At the smallest and largest subsample sizes too few pairs fall in the usable z range, so those rows are NaN.

I'm still waiting on the CI/random job. When it ends I'll rebuild the survival curves, comment on #2, close it, and send story-repo the C1–C6 interpretation.
